translations.web: The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.
translations.bsb: The heart of the righteous ponders how to answer, but the mouth of the wicked blurts out evil.
translations.kjv: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.
translations.asv: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer; But the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.
